scope: Primary README of 20 source repositories (Anthropic actual SKILL.md); actual SKILL.md for 13 skill entries; selected official API/registry docs. Summaries are original, not copied full documentation. Re-read exact version-specific docs before execution.

taste.fit: Distinctive new company/marketing pages; one visual system, business-specific page plan and browser finish checks.
taste.avoid: Do not impose a marketing-page layout, full-screen sections, fixed navigation, random font/palette choices or generated imagery on a dashboard or an established brand. Project requirements override house style.
taste.use: Read page-kind guidance and house rules; choose a concrete layout/example and validate the actual output.

sources.locator: House rules; The page plan by kind; The run; Checklist

taste.evidence: documentation reviewed; no independent visual benchmark

impeccable.fit: Targeted interface shaping, layout, type, color, review and refinement; commands and project design context.
impeccable.avoid: Do not load all commands, initialize context files or enable hooks without permission; not a second primary design owner.
impeccable.use: Read relevant command and project PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md; use critique/audit as review rather than proof.

sources.locator: Setup; How to design; Commands

uiux-pro-max.fit: Searchable design-system, UX, visual hierarchy and framework guidance; suitable for planning, not a component runtime.
uiux-pro-max.avoid: Search results are candidates, not permission to override brand tokens or select premium content. Avoid global CLI changes without approval.
uiux-pro-max.use: Run a focused design-system query or domain search and retain the actual returned pattern and stack-specific guidance.

hallmark.fit: Alternative new-page visual direction with structured references and review.
hallmark.avoid: Its upstream skill restricts existing-design use to explicitly named Hallmark requests. Do not select for a redesign by default or combine with Taste.
